Container.Name: SysMonitor
Container.Overview: Syslog server, status monitor and local-AI digests for your home lab, published to Home Assistant over MQTT. Recommendations only: it never changes anything.
Container.Description: SysMonitor receives syslog on UDP/TCP 5514 (Unraid, UniFi including IDS/IPS alerts, Nginx Proxy Manager access logs, Linux hosts) and JSON over HTTP (Home Assistant via Node-RED, NetSentry). Rules turn log lines into issues; pollers add Unraid array and disk state, ZFS pool health, CPU temperature, containers that should be running, and image updates. A local Ollama model writes hourly, daily and weekly digests with recommendations.[br][br]Home Assistant gets a "SysMonitor" device with 15 entities via MQTT discovery; a ready-made dashboard and notification automations are in the project repository.[br][br]Uses host networking by default; see the project README for running it on its own br0 address. Works out of the box as a syslog server. Edit config.yaml in the Config path to add MQTT and name your sources, then restart. Remove the Docker socket mapping if you prefer not to grant it; only read requests are made.
Container.Requires: MQTT broker for Home Assistant entities (optional). Ollama for AI digests (optional). NetSentry for network scan status (optional).

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: config.yaml; a default is written on first start.

Config.Name: NetSentry data
Config.Description: NetSentry's data folder, read-only. Leave empty if you don't run NetSentry.

Config.Name: Unraid state
Config.Description: Unraid array and disk status, read-only.

Config.Name: Update status
Config.Description: Unraid's container update check results. Remove if the file doesn't exist yet.

Config.Name: Autostart list
Config.Description: Which containers should be running. Remove if the file doesn't exist yet.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Container state. Only GET requests are made, but the socket grants full Docker control; remove to opt out.

Config.Name: MQTT password
Config.Description: Password for the MQTT user in config.yaml.

Config.Name: Ingest token
Config.Description: Optional shared secret for POST /ingest (header X-SysMonitor-Token).

Config.Name: Digest on start
Config.Description: true = write a daily digest when the container starts (for testing).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for schedules and reports.
